speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Bronchiectasis. The combination of a chronic productive cough with copious purulent sputum, recurrent "bronchitis" exacerbations requiring antibiotics, morning worsening, and non-smoker status is classic for bronchiectasis. The High-Resolution CT images I requested will likely confirm the diagnosis by showing dilated, thick-walled bronchi with possible the "signet ring" sign.
